summary.headline: EXEM to buy back up to KRW 1bn of common shares, for price stabilization and shareholder value
summary.what_happened: On Nov 23, 2026, EXEM CO., LTD. resolved by board decision to acquire 204,081 common shares, with an expected acquisition amount of KRW 999,996,900, through direct on-exchange purchases via Samsung Securities, over a planned period from Nov 24, 2026 to Dec 23, 2026. The stated purpose is price stabilization and enhancing shareholder value.

key_numbers.label: Treasury shares held before this decision
key_numbers.value: 528,266 shares (3.9% per filing for the 524,829 shares acquired within distributable profit limits)

summary.why_it_matters: Share buybacks of this kind are generally announced by Korean companies to support the share price or to return value to shareholders, and the repurchased shares may later be sold or cancelled, which can affect the number of shares outstanding. The actual number of shares and amount acquired may be lower than the planned figures depending on market conditions.
